title: The verdict a plan-review turn answers with
description: The structured answer `oneharness.plan-review.toml` validates every review turn against, and the whole contract between the reviewer and `orchestrator/plan_review.py`, which records a pass only when `passes` is true and records nothing at all otherwise. Two required fields and nothing beside them: a reviewer that answered with its own commentary, a severity, or a rewritten task would have that extra silently ignored, so the schema refuses it here — where oneharness re-prompts — rather than downstream where nothing is watching. This file is hashed into every review key, so editing it invalidates every record made under the previous version.

passes.description: Whether this task's authored content may be dispatched. False records nothing, so the task stays refused by `just check-plan` until its content changes and is reviewed again.

reason.description: One sentence saying why. On a refusal it is what the operator is shown and the only thing that says what to correct, so it names the criterion rather than the impression.
